column1: # Faithful transcription of the tube→lane rows; one row per (lane, tube).
#   lane       ARC lane name as written in the record (ARC04 = GEX04; ARC0S = the
#              "symmetry breaking" lane, aligned to both duck (GEX0S-duck) and
#   tube       tube label as written in the record.  CAUTION: the record's duck tube
#              labels "17-A"/"17-B" are NOT the repo embryo IDs 17-A/17-B (those
#              are the PILOTGEX4 embryos).  lane-loading-record tube -> repo embryos:
#                17-B(2) -> 17-5, 17-6   (left halves; ONE tube split across ARC04 + ARC0S)
#                17-A(2) -> 17-7, 17-8   (right halves in ARC04, left halves in ARC0S)
#   embryos_n  the "(n)" in the tube label = number of embryos in the tube.
#   side       L / R half as written in the record.
#   split_color  record cell colour; the SAME colour in two lanes = ONE tube split
#              across both lanes (same tissue).  Empty = no colour in the record.
#   - The ARC0S note says "10 embryos" but the lane holds 12 (8 chick + 4 duck).
#   - First batch used individual tubes per embryo group, which allowed one tube
#     to be split into two lanes; this was not repeated (later batches pooled).
#   - ARC03 (which held 17-B(2)-R among others) was struck and never run, so the
#     right halves of 17-5/17-6 were never sequenced.
#   - Splitting the chick left tubes into ARC0S did not help resolve chick embryo
#     identity (design error); the chick part is left as is.
